description: Bounded public disposition for Alice throughput records: the historical Vulkan configuration of record at 18.430 t/s decode-only with an independent 18.360 re-anchor, the current clean ROCm/HIP raw K0 at 15.374/15.422 t/s, the standing backend policy (ROCm/HIP production, Vulkan parity oracle), and the prefill record including the 662.744 t/s hot run at pp2048/ub4096 with its cold/warm companions. The executing runtime tree, model weights, container bytes, and raw receipts are excluded from publication; values below are sanitized summaries of campaign-local receipts.
model_name: AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B-Base (custom alice_ai hybrid KDA linear-attention + MoE)
model_revision: source checkpoint; the quantized container is excluded from publication
model_download_source: public base checkpoint exists; no weight payload or container byte is part of this repository
quant_name: Q3.9-MIX (52 x Q4_K + 44 x Q3_K expert tensors, trunk q8_0, control f32)
hardware_phenotype: RX9060XT16-NITRO-GFX1200-RADV-2026.08.27-v1; RX 9060 XT 16 GB, gfx1200; Vulkan/RADV build and a separate ROCm/HIP build of the same research runtime
gpu_configuration: RX 9060 XT 16 GB, gfx1200; Vulkan/RADV build and a separate ROCm/HIP build of the same research runtime
prompt: campaign prefill prompt shape: 2048-token requests with unique nonces and cache_prompt disabled
context_size: 8192 for the prefill arms; the decode record of record is decode-only
warmup: three identical-shape requests per arm, labelled COLD (rep0), WARM (rep1), HOT (rep2)

tolerance.prefill_tps: state-sensitive; 662.7437 is a hot-run measurement, not a stable baseline
tolerance.decode_tps: single-session comparisons only; cross-session ratios are not used

known_limitations: 18.430 t/s is a HISTORICAL Vulkan figure and is not current HIP performance.
The HIP comparison and the Vulkan record come from different source trees, so the delta is not yet a backend attribution.
662.7437 t/s is the third request of a warm-repeat and must not be advertised as a universally reproducible baseline.
The 71.105 t/s baseline belongs to a different session, ubatch, and offload configuration; the derived 9.3x ratio is inadmissible.
ub2048 is unusable as a control (84-298% spread).
